description: React component for configuring Text-to-Speech providers, including voice selection, credential handling, testing TTS output, and saving configuration within a chatflow application.

methods.name: resetTestAudio
methods.description: Revokes previous test audio URL, resets test audio state, and waveform reset flag.

methods.name: onSave
methods.description: Saves the current TTS configuration to the chatflow via API and updates state.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Updates the TTS configuration state with new input values, manages provider activation, and resets test audio if necessary.

methods.name: handleProviderChange
methods.description: Handles switching between different TTS providers, loads voices if credentials are available.

methods.name: loadVoicesForProvider
methods.description: Fetches available voices for a selected provider using its credential ID.

methods.name: testTTS
methods.description: Triggers a test TTS request, processes streaming SSE response, and sets test audio source.

methods.name: parseSSEEvent
methods.description: Parses server-sent events from TTS streaming response to extract audio chunks.

methods.name: handleTestPlay
methods.description: Plays the generated test audio, triggers generation if audio is not yet available.

methods.name: handleTestEnded
methods.description: Handles end of test audio playback.
